usedFor: Adafruit IO logs sensor feeds, and Anthropic Claude answers on them when “New Feed Data” triggers “Generate Response”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feed Data” in Adafruit IO, then “Generate Response” in Anthropic Claude
bestTemplate.why: Each fresh reading becomes the prompt, so Claude can explain or flag it while the data is current.

watchOut: “New Feed Data” is polling, so “Generate Response” runs after a scheduled check, not on each reading.
